# Wikilivre Documentation & Entertainment Hub

> > A comprehensive resource combining French administrative documentation (Sécurité Sociale, Pôle Emploi), technical tutorials (Python, Power BI), TV entertainment guides (Netflix, TV Guide), and internet culture references (Know Your Meme, TikTok trends).

Wikilivre serves as a multi-purpose knowledge platform aggregating official French social security documents, programming tutorials from Tutorialspoint, TV streaming recommendations from TV Guide, and viral meme explanations from Know Your Meme. The site bridges administrative resources, technical education, and entertainment culture in one searchable repository.

## Key Topics

- French Sécurité Sociale
- Pôle Emploi attestations
- Netflix streaming recommendations
- TV Guide listings
- Know Your Meme explanations
- TikTok viral trends
- Python 3 programming
- Power BI tutorials
- Identity authentication documents
- Catchphrase memes
- TV schedule and entertainment news
- Tutorialspoint technical guides
- Viral video culture
- French administrative documents

## TV & Streaming Entertainment

- [TV Guide Homepage](https://tvguide.com): TV Guide homepage with streaming recommendations and entertainment news
- [TV Listings](https://tvguide.com/Listings): TV Guide listings and channel information for shows and movies
- [Best Shows on Netflix (March 2026)](https://tvguide.com/news/the-best-shows-on-netflix): Curated list of 55 best Netflix shows including Vladimir and Bridgerton
- [Best Movies on Netflix (March 2026)](https://tvguide.com/news/best-movies-on-netflix): 61 best Netflix movies featuring Jurassic World Rebirth and more
- [Live Sports Schedule](https://tvguide.com/sports/live-today): Live sports schedule for today with MLB, NBA, NHL, and soccer games
- [Winter TV Guide 2025-2026](https://tvguide.com/news/features/winter-tv-guide-2025): Comprehensive winter 2025-2026 TV season guide with streaming premieres
- [New Shows Winter 2026](https://tvguide.com/galleries/the-new-shows-of-the-2025-2026-winter-tv-season): 2026 winter TV season new shows including Game of Thrones and Star Trek

## French Administrative Documents

- [Sécurité Sociale Attestations](https://docs.wikilivre.org/topic/attestation-securite-sociale): French Sécurité Sociale administrative documents and attestations
- [Pôle Emploi Documents](https://docs.wikilivre.org/topic/pointage-pole-emploi): Pôle Emploi attestation and job seeker forms documentation
- [Caisse de Retraite Documents](https://docs.wikilivre.org/topic/caisse-de-retraite-securite-sociale): Caisse de Retraite and Sécurité Sociale retirement documents
- [Identity Authentication Management](https://docs.wikilivre.org/topic/identity-authentication-management): Identity authentication attestation documents and guides
